uniteMoveEffects.name: Revenant Rend
uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: Ceruledge charges both of their arm blades gaining unstoppable and 70% Damage reduction for 0.5s before slashing through to the designated location, leaving Ceruledge unable to act for 0.7s. Ceruledge also leaves enemies hit unable to act for 0.7s and applies a mark to them. After 0.7s, marked enemies are dealt damage with three slashing blows. The mark can be cleansed, preventing the damage. Unite buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
